1.english_reference: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon

traditions.WLC: וּ מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֗א שָֽׁמְעָה֮ אֶת שֵׁ֣מַע שְׁלֹמֹה֒
traditions.LXX: Καὶ βασίλισσα Σαβὰ ἤκουσεν τὸ ὄνομα Σαλωμών ,
traditions.VUL: Regína quoque Saba , cum audísset famam Salomónis ,
traditions.KJV: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon ,

1.english_reference: she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּב֣וֹא לְ נַסּוֹת֩ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה בְ חִיד֜וֹת בִּ ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν τοῦ πειράσαι Σαλωμὼν ἐν αἰνίγμασιν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: venit ut tentáret eum in ænigmátibus in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem ,

1.english_reference: with a very great company , and camels that bare spices , and gold in abundance , and precious stones

traditions.WLC: בְּ חַ֣יִל כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֡ד וּ֠ גְמַלִּים נֹשְׂאִ֨ים בְּשָׂמִ֧ים וְ זָהָ֛ב לָ רֹ֖ב וְ אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἐν δυνάμει βαρείᾳ σφόδρα , καὶ κὰμηλοι αἴρουσαι ἀρώματα καὶ χρυσίον εἰς πλῆθος καὶ λίθον τίμιον ·
traditions.VUL: cum magnis ópibus et camélis , qui portábant arómata , et auri plúrimum , gemmásque pretiósas .
traditions.KJV: with a very great company , and camels that bare spices , and gold in abundance , and precious stones :

1.english_reference: and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּבוֹא֙ אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַ תְּדַבֵּ֣ר עִמּ֔ וֹ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם לְבָבָֽ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς Σαλωμὼν καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντα ὅσα ἐν τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτῆς .
traditions.VUL: Cumque venísset ad Salomónem , locúta est ei quæcúmque erant in corde suo .
traditions.KJV: and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .

2.english_reference: And Solomon told her all her questions

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּגֶּד לָ֥ הּ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֶת כָּל דְּבָרֶ֑י הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν αὐτῇ Σαλωμὼν πάντας τοὺς λόγους αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: Et expósuit ei Sálomon ómnia quæ proposúerat :
traditions.KJV: And Solomon told her all her questions :

2.english_reference: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא נֶעְלַ֤ם דָּבָר֙ מִ שְּׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹ֦א הִגִּ֖יד לָֽ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ παρῆλθεν λόγος ἀπὸ Σαλωμών , λόγος ὃν οὐκ ἀπήγγειλε αὐτῇ .
traditions.VUL: nec quidquam fuit , quod non perspícuum ei fécerit .
traditions.KJV: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not .

3.english_reference: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon

traditions.WLC: וַ תֵּ֨רֶא֙ מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֔א אֵ֖ת חָכְמַ֣ת שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶδεν βασίλισσα Σαβά τὴν σοφίαν Σαλωμὼν
traditions.VUL: Quæ postquam vidit , sapiéntiam scílicet Salomónis ,
traditions.KJV: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon ,

3.english_reference: and the house that he had built

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν οἶκον ὃν οἰκοδόμησεν ,
traditions.VUL: et domum quam ædificáverat ,
traditions.KJV: and the house that he had built ,

4.english_reference: And the meat of his table

traditions.WLC: וּ מַאֲכַ֣ל שֻׁלְחָנ֡ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ βρώματα τῶν τραπεζῶν
traditions.VUL: necnon et cibária mensæ eius ,
traditions.KJV: And the meat of his table ,

4.english_reference: and the sitting of his servants

traditions.WLC: וּ מוֹשַׁ֣ב עֲבָדָי ו֩
traditions.LXX: καὶ καθέδραν παίδων αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et habitácula servórum ,
traditions.KJV: and the sitting of his servants ,

4.english_reference: and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel

traditions.WLC: וּ מַעֲמַ֨ד מְשָׁרְתָ֜י ו וּ מַלְבּֽוּשֵׁי הֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ στάσιν λειτουργῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἱματισμὸν αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: et offícia ministrórum eius , et vestiménta eórum ,
traditions.KJV: and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel ;

4.english_reference: his cupbearers also , and their apparel

traditions.WLC: וּ מַשְׁקָי ו֙ וּ מַלְבּ֣וּשֵׁי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἰνοχόων αὐτοῦ , καὶ στολισμὸν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: pincérnas quoque et vestes eórum ,
traditions.KJV: his cupbearers also , and their apparel ;

4.english_reference: and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲלִיָּת֔ וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα ἃ ἀνέφερεν ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: et víctimas quas immolábat in domo Dómini :
traditions.KJV: and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD ;

4.english_reference: there was no more spirit in her

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא הָ֥יָה ע֛וֹד בָּ֖ הּ רֽוּחַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξ ἑαυτῆς ἐγένετο .
traditions.VUL: non erat præ stupóre ultra in ea spíritus .
traditions.KJV: there was no more spirit in her .

5.english_reference: And she said to the king

traditions.WLC: וַ תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα
traditions.VUL: Dixítque ad regem :
traditions.KJV: And she said to the king , [

5.english_reference: It was a true report which I heard in mine own land

traditions.WLC: אֱמֶת֙ הַ דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בְּ אַרְצִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: Ἀληθινὸς ὁ λόγος ὃν ἤκουσα ἐν τῇ γῇ μου
traditions.VUL: Verus est sermo , quem audíeram in terra mea
traditions.KJV: It was ] a true report which I heard in mine own land

5.english_reference: of thine acts , and of thy wisdom

traditions.WLC: עַל דְּבָרֶ֖י ךָ וְ עַל חָכְמָתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: περὶ τῶν λόγων σου καὶ περὶ τῆς σοφίας σου .
traditions.VUL: de virtútibus et sapiéntia tua .
traditions.KJV: of thine acts , and of thy wisdom :

6.english_reference: Howbeit I believed not their words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא הֶאֱמַ֣נְתִּי לְ דִבְרֵי הֶ֗ם עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר בָּ֨אתִי֙ וַ תִּרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינַ֔ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐπίστευσα τοῖς λόγοις ἕως οὗ ἦλθον καὶ εἶδον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ,
traditions.VUL: Non credébam narrántibus donec ipsa veníssem , et vidíssent óculi mei ,
traditions.KJV: Howbeit I believed not their words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen [ it ] :

6.english_reference: and , behold , the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנֵּה֙ לֹ֣א הֻגַּד לִ֔ י חֲצִ֖י מַרְבִּ֣ית חָכְמָתֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἀπηγγέλη μοι ἥμισυ τοῦ πλήθους τῆς σοφίας σου ·
traditions.VUL: et probássem vix medietátem sapiéntiæ tuæ mihi fuísse narrátam :
traditions.KJV: and , behold , the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me : [

6.english_reference: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard

traditions.WLC: יָסַ֕פְתָּ עַל הַ שְּׁמוּעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתִּי
traditions.LXX: προσέθηκας ἐπὶ τὴν ἀκοὴν ἣν ἤκουσα .
traditions.VUL: vicísti famam virtútibus tuis .
traditions.KJV: for ] thou exceedest the fame that I heard .

7.english_reference: Happy are thy men , and happy are these thy servants

traditions.WLC: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אֲנָשֶׁ֔י ךָ וְ אַשְׁרֵ֖י עֲבָדֶ֣י ךָ
traditions.LXX: μακάριοι οἱ ἄνδρες , μακάριοι οἱ παῖδές σου
traditions.VUL: Beáti viri tui , et beáti servi tui ,
traditions.KJV: Happy [ are ] thy men , and happy [ are ] these thy servants ,

traditions.WLC: אֵ֑לֶּה הָ עֹמְדִ֤ים לְ פָנֶ֨י ךָ֙ תָּמִ֔יד
traditions.LXX: οὗτοι οἱ παρεστηκότες σοι διὰ παντός ,
traditions.VUL: qui assístunt coram te omni témpore ,
traditions.KJV: which stand continually before thee ,

traditions.WLC: וְ שֹׁמְעִ֖ים אֶת חָכְמָתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἀκούουσιν σοφίαν σου .
traditions.VUL: et áudiunt sapiéntiam tuam .
traditions.KJV: and hear thy wisdom .

8.english_reference: Blessed be the LORD thy God

traditions.WLC: יְהִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י ךָ֙ בָּר֔וּךְ
traditions.LXX: ἔστω Κύριος ὁ θεός σου ηὐλογημένος
traditions.VUL: Sit Dóminus Deus tuus benedíctus ,
traditions.KJV: Blessed be the LORD thy God ,

8.english_reference: which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne , to be king for the LORD thy God

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפֵ֣ץ בְּ ךָ֗ לְ תִתְּ ךָ֤ עַל כִּסְא וֹ֙ לְ מֶ֔לֶךְ לַ יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὃς ἠθέλησέν σοι τοῦ δοῦναί σε ἐπὶ θρόνον αὐτοῦ εἰς βασιλέα τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ σου ·
traditions.VUL: qui vóluit te ordináre super thronum suum , regem Dómini Dei tui .
traditions.KJV: which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne , [ to be ] king for the LORD thy God :

8.english_reference: because thy God loved Israel , to establish them for ever

traditions.WLC: בְּ אַהֲבַ֨ת אֱלֹהֶ֤י ךָ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ הַעֲמִיד֣ וֹ לְ עוֹלָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ ἀγαπῆσαι Κύριον τὸν θεόν σου τὸν Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ στῆσαι αὐτὸν εἰς αἰῶνα ,
traditions.VUL: Quia díligit Deus Israel , et vult serváre eum in ætérnum ,
traditions.KJV: because thy God loved Israel , to establish them for ever ,

8.english_reference: therefore made he thee king over them , to do judgment and justice

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֶּנְ ךָ֤ עֲלֵי הֶם֙ לְ מֶ֔לֶךְ לַ עֲשׂ֖וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ צְדָקָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκέν σε ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς εἰς βασιλέα τοῦ ποιῆσαι κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην .
traditions.VUL: idcírco pósuit te super eum regem ut fácias iudícia atque iustítiam .
traditions.KJV: therefore made he thee king over them , to do judgment and justice .

9.english_reference: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold , and of spices great abundance , and precious stones

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּתֵּ֨ן לַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה וְ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים כִּכַּ֣ר זָהָ֗ב וּ בְשָׂמִ֛ים לָ רֹ֥ב מְאֹ֖ד וְ אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ βασιλεῖ ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι τάλαντα χρυσίου καὶ ἀρώματα εἰς πλῆθος πολὺ καὶ λίθον τίμιον ·
traditions.VUL: Dedit autem regi centum vigínti talénta auri , et arómata multa nimis , et gemmas pretiosíssimas :
traditions.KJV: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold , and of spices great abundance , and precious stones :

9.english_reference: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֤א הָיָה֙ כַּ בֹּ֣שֶׂם הַ ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁר נָתְנָ֥ה מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֖א לַ מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἦν κατὰ τὰ ἀρώματα ἐκεῖνα ἃ ἔδωκεν βασίλισσα Σαβὰ τῷ βασιλεῖ Σαλωμών .
traditions.VUL: non fuérunt arómata tália ut hæc , quæ dedit regína Saba regi Salomóni .
traditions.KJV: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon .

10.english_reference: And the servants also of Huram , and the servants of Solomon , which brought gold from Ophir

traditions.WLC: וְ גַם עַבְדֵ֤י חירם וְ עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֥יאוּ זָהָ֖ב מֵ אוֹפִ֑יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ παῖδες Σαλωμὼν καὶ οἱ παῖδες Χειρὰμ ἔφερον χρυσίον τῷ Σαλωμὼν ἐκ Σουφεὶρ
traditions.VUL: Sed et servi Hiram cum servis Salomónis attulérunt aurum de Ophir ,
traditions.KJV: And the servants also of Huram , and the servants of Solomon , which brought gold from Ophir ,

10.english_reference: brought algum trees and precious stones

traditions.WLC: הֵבִ֛יאוּ עֲצֵ֥י אַלְגּוּמִּ֖ים וְ אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ξύλα πεύκινα καὶ λίθον τίμιον .
traditions.VUL: et ligna thýina , et gemmas pretiosíssimas :
traditions.KJV: brought algum trees and precious stones .

11.english_reference: And the king made [ of ] the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD , and to the king ’s palace

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֣עַשׂ הַ֠ מֶּלֶךְ אֶת עֲצֵ֨י הָֽ אַלְגּוּמִּ֜ים מְסִלּ֤וֹת לְ בֵית יְהוָה֙ וּ לְ בֵ֣ית הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὰ ξύλα τὰ πεύκινα ἀναβάσεις τῷ οἴκῳ Κυρίου καὶ τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: de quibus fecit rex , de lignis scílicet thýinis , gradus in domo Dómini , et in domo régia ,
traditions.KJV: And the king made [ of ] the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD , and to the king ’s palace ,

11.english_reference: and harps and psalteries for singers

traditions.WLC: וְ כִנֹּר֥וֹת וּ נְבָלִ֖ים לַ שָּׁרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ κιθάρας καὶ νάβλας τοῖς ᾠδοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: cítharas quoque , et psaltéria cantóribus :
traditions.KJV: and harps and psalteries for singers :

11.english_reference: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא נִרְא֥וּ כָ הֵ֛ם לְ פָנִ֖ים בְּ אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ὤφθησαν τοιαῦτα ἔμπροσθεν ἐν γῇ Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: numquam visa sunt in terra Iuda ligna tália .
traditions.KJV: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah .

12.english_reference: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה נָתַ֣ן לְ מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֗א אֶת כָּל חֶפְצָ הּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔לָה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμὼν ἔδωκεν τῇ βασιλίσσῃ Σαβὰ πάντα τὰ θελήματα αὐτῆς ἃ ᾔτησεν ,
traditions.VUL: Rex autem Sálomon dedit regínæ Saba cuncta quæ vóluit , et quæ postulávit ,
traditions.KJV: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked ,

12.english_reference: beside [ that ] which she had brought unto the king

traditions.WLC: מִ לְּ בַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֣יאָה אֶל הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐκτὸς πάντων ὧν ἤνεγκεν τῷ βασιλεῖ Σαλωμών ·
traditions.VUL: et multo plura quam attúlerat ad eum :
traditions.KJV: beside [ that ] which she had brought unto the king .

12.english_reference: So she turned , and went away to her own land , she and her servants

traditions.WLC: וַֽ תַּהֲפֹ֛ךְ וַ תֵּ֥לֶךְ לְ אַרְצָ֖ הּ הִ֥יא וַ עֲבָדֶֽי הָ
traditions.LXX: ἀπέστρεψεν εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτῆς .
traditions.VUL: quæ revérsa ábiit in terram suam cum servis suis .
traditions.KJV: So she turned , and went away to her own land , she and her servants .

13.english_reference: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי֙ מִשְׁקַ֣ל הַ זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥א לִ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּ שָׁנָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וְ שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וָ שֵׁ֖שׁ כִּכְּרֵ֥י זָהָֽב
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἦν ὁ σταθμὸς τοῦ χρυσίου τοῦ ἐνεχθέντος τῷ Σαλωμὼν ἐν ἐνιαυτῷ ἑνὶ ἑξακόσια ἑξήκοντα ἓξ τάλαντα χρυσίου ,
traditions.VUL: Erat autem pondus auri quod afferebátur Salomóni per síngulos annos , sexcénta sexagínta sex talénta auri ,
traditions.KJV: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold ;
